title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs bug fix and enhancement update
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in libfontenc's font encoding parser due to improper validation of dimensions when processing .enc files. A local attacker can exploit this by placing a crafted encoding file in a directory read by a privileged process such as an X server, potentially causing local privilege escalation or denial of service by crashing the process. The vulnerability is rated Important by Red Hat, with a CVSS base score of 7.8, and affects configurations running Xorg with root privileges. Typical deployments running display servers under unprivileged accounts limit the impact to local session users. The issue is addressed in updated libfontenc RPMs provided by Red Hat Hardened Images.
